summary: From the users list, this code collects the names whose active value is True into active_names, then prints the result. In this example, it prints ['A'].
flowSummary: Main flow: user list setup 1 · result list setup 1 · loop 1 · condition 1 · append 1 · output 1
stepTexts: Store the user list in users | The list contains information for A and B. Each item has a name value and an active value.
Prepare an empty active_names list | This creates an empty container that will later hold names that match the condition.
Check each user in users | The user variable receives A's information first, then B's information.
Check the active value | Only users whose user['active'] value is True run the indented code below.
Add the matching name | If the condition matches, user['name'] is added to active_names. In this example, only A is added.
Print the final result | This prints the final active_names result, ['A'], to the screen.
